fields.label: Seller
fields.description: The reviewed seller (a real Frappe User, same as Souq Masr Listing.owner). owner is Frappe's standard field — the reviewer. One row per (owner, seller) pair, upserted by souq_masr.api.v1.reviews.submit_review, not inserted fresh each time.

fields.label: Rating
fields.description: 1-5, validated both in submit_review and in this DocType's own validate() (defense in depth, same pattern as Souq Masr Listing's price validation).

fields.label: Comment
fields.description: Optional free-text comment, matches the mobile rating sheet's optional comment field.
